card.name: Decimal point inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: The decimal point right after a single digit in a dose or lab limit, such as 2.5 mg or 1.5 times ULN. It expects another digit next.

modes.label: Dose amounts
modes.description: Decimal point after a whole number in a drug dose in mg or g.
modes.example: The recommended initial dose of moexipril hydrochloride tablets in patients not receiving diuretics is 7<<.>>5 mg, one hour prior to meals

modes.label: Lab limits
modes.description: Decimal point in a multiple of the upper limit of normal for bilirubin or enzymes.

card.writes: It promotes digit tokens, so the model writes a digit after the decimal point.
card.plain: It fires on the decimal point in a number like 2.5 and prepares the next digit.
